title: Not worth the money, I need a refund
text: Purchased as a monthly surprise for a family member with dementia. He was so excited to get it! One month I happened to be there when he got it. To my surprise it’s $5 worth of the candy almost no one likes. 3 Hershey kisses, some candy buttons and waxy juicy things, 3 different caramels and some mints for $30? While the family member is excited and enjoys the candy (at this point any candy is enjoyed more than food) , there’s $20 a month that needs accounted for. Needless to say after almost 2 years of money going to buy this monthly I feel completely taken advantage of. Don’t buy this.
label: negative
